text: Ori Osherov I'm so aware. Everytime he speaks, I can feel it. If I were a one-issue voter - his party would be my pick. But will his party end up having a coalition with an extremist party who insists on being in charge of the Population Authority as part of their deal of joining the coalition? If i knew for a fact that HE, or ministers from his party, would be in charge of the Population Authority, i'd be so excited.
